meta.name: Aegean Kai no Shizuku
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 6.00 MB

A first person point-and-click, very similar to American PC games like Myst, where you play as Triton and explore various realms to hunt down four swords. Although there are plenty of strange and unique characters to encounter, the narrative is relatively slim, which is a huge departure from typical Japanese adventure games; meanwhile, the puzzles are easier than the mindbenders typically found Myst-style point-and-clicks.
The PC98 version is interesting because it's one of the only games of these type to feature anime-style visuals; in contrast, Myst and all of its clones used prerendered computer graphics. The human characters in this release are attractively drawn albeit typical, while the backgrounds have a colorfully surreal element that's missing from their Western counterparts (the Windows 95 CD-ROM edition, however, is basically the same exact game but using CGI instead).

Continues the story that was told in the first Brandish, depicting the events that happened three years after the evil demonic king was defeated in his lost kingdom, sunken deep underground. The player takes control of a young warrior named Ares, who wields a powerful sword called the Planet Buster. One day, while traveling through a desert, Ares is captured by a warlock named Karl, who is after the powers hidden within the magical sword. Suspecting Ares might have some valuable information, Karl doesn't execute him, but takes away the Planet Buster and throws Ares into his underground prison. Now the primary goal is to guide Ares out of the huge prison full of various dangers, and get the mighty weapon back. The player guides Ares through rotating dungeons, fighting enemies in real-time combat, casting spells, and solving an occasional puzzle. The protagonist has the ability to jump forwards and attack inanimate objects (such as doors) to cause damage and eventually break them.

This game is an enhanced version of Cyber ​​Academy 1, released in 1989, featuring modifications to event images and other enhancements. Set in a 3,000-year-old Cyber ​​Academy where only beautiful girls pass the graduation exam, the game involves taking a test to graduate as a special student. Parodies of various anime and games can be seen throughout, and the structure involves progressing through the story in Adventure Mode and competing in quizzes in Battle Mode. Although the quizzes are simple O/X questions, they require extensive general knowledge. Each of the four stages features 25 questions, requiring players to answer 80% correctly to advance to the next level, demonstrating a considerably high difficulty. Like games of that era, it takes the form of a strip game, but it does not feel particularly lewd.

En una isla aislada se encuentra un instituto de investigación. Al parecer, las investigaciones que allí se llevan a cabo tienen un vínculo no oficial con el ejército. Mientras tanto, el director técnico Makoto Izumi parece creer que algo extraño está ocurriendo con la investigación.
Desire es un juego de aventuras de estilo japonés. El juego se desarrolla a través de una interfaz estándar basada en texto, en la que el jugador selecciona comandos de un menú e interactúa con otros personajes y lugares. El juego consta de cuatro capítulos que componen la misma historia, pero vista a través de los ojos de diferentes personajes. En cada capítulo, el jugador verá sucesos y situaciones desde distintos ángulos y descubrirá capas de la trama principal.

Farland Story is the first in the row of successful Japanese strategy RPG games. The main hero of the game is a knight named Arc, who is in love with the beautiful priestess Ferio. One day, when Arc and his best friend Randia are out of town, a hostile army under the command of a mysterious Black Knight invades the town and kidnaps Ferio. Thus begins Arc's quest to defeat the enemies and to rescue his beloved one from their clutches.
Farland Story consists entirely of battles (save cut scenes and the ability to shop if you are near a town after a battle). During battles, you move Arc and his party over the terrain, and attack when there are enemies in range. The party consists of different classes - knights attack with swords, archers specialize in long-ranged combat, priestesses heal, etc. Every attack leads to a counter-attack, from the enemy's side as well as from yours. You gain experience points for every attack, and can level up in the middle of a battle.

There are also four different modes of play for single or multi player, in this case more like party play. The animations vary from optical illusions to simple CG.

A magical world populated by supernatural creatures exists alongside ours. Once in a while a portal between the two opens. Demons known as BEMs ("big-eyed monsters") have stolen precious jewels and escaped to Earth through that portal. It is up to two demon hunters, Lime and Bass, to assume the likeness of a teenage girl and boy and restore peace and order.
Hōma Hunter Lime is the first episode of a series, built like an interactive cartoon with visual novel elements. The interaction is sparse, consisting of repeatedly selecting simple verb commands from a menu and triggering animated cutscenes.

Puedes jugar en dos campañas contra la computadora que requieren que derrotes a los magos enemigos en todos los mapas y te permite llevar todas las unidades que han sobrevivido a una batalla a la siguiente. Tu mago y tus monstruos ganan experiencia luchando y las habilidades de tus monstruos difieren mucho entre sí.

meta.path: ./Three Sisters Story [T-En by JAST USA][Port by Alpharobo, Kirinn B & BabaJeanmel v1.0].zip
meta.name: Sanshimai
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.03 MB

Koichi once lived in a happy and somewhat rich family. He was only a boy when his father decided to stop the running train by himself. Koichi's mother died of cancer, and he got separated from his older brother Eiichi. Ten years have passed since that moment. One day, Eiichi, now wealthy and powerful, returns, telling Koichi that the man responsible for their father's ruin was Shoji Okamura. He plans to destroy Okamura family entirely, and he buys Koichi a house nearby, telling him to gain their trust in order to create a perfect timing for his revenge.
However, Shoji Okamura ran away, abandoning the house along with his daughters. The eldest one had to leave college and get a job in order to support her sisters, and the whole family was beginning to sink deeper and deeper into debts. Eiichi is planning to punish the sisters for their father's sins, but Koichi's feelings begin to change as he gets to know them better, and the moment is nearing when he will have to choose his destiny.

Reimu Hakurei, the young shrine maiden, has left the Hakurei shrine to train her newly discovered powers with the magical Yin-Yang orbs. When she returns, she finds the shrine desecrated, invaded by powerful demons. Riding her new friend, the turtle Genji, Reimu has to fight her way through hordes of enemies in order to defeat their demonic lords.
The second installment in the Tōhō series abandons the breakout/shooter hybrid concept of the first game in favor of more traditional vertically scrolling shooter gameplay. The turtle replaces the traditional space ship, but otherwise Tōhō: Fūmaroku plays very similarly to other so-called bullet hell shooters, with multiple enemies on the screen attacking at once, and ferocious bosses with their unique attack patterns. Reimu's turtle can upgrade its shooting abilities by eating various letters dropped from above. Reimu can also use a limited amount of bombs, which cause massive damage to all the enemies at once.

Juegas en el papel de un joven llamado Custom. Siempre te ha gustado luchar, pero aún no has encontrado la forma de desarrollar tu talento. Un día, paseando por el campo, conoces a una hermosa chica llamada Kumiko, que te habla del campeonato "Battling Gods" que se organiza en su pueblo. Las condiciones parecen buenas para Custom, pero pronto se da cuenta de que es demasiado débil para participar, y que tiene que bajar a las mazmorras cercanas a luchar contra monstruos y hacerse más fuerte, para tener más posibilidades de ganar el gran premio.
La navegación por la ciudad y la interacción con los personajes se realizan en primera persona. Exploras mazmorras y luchas contra enemigos que aparecen aleatoriamente en batallas por turnos. En la ciudad, puedes alojarte en una posada, comprar provisiones o participar en el torneo del Coliseo.

The protagonist of the game is assigned to supervise and lead a group known as Tuned Heart, which fights crime on city streets. The members of the group are all young and pretty girls, and also experts in firearms and vehicles. Mysterious mind-controlling criminals have appeared in America, and now cities are overrun by biker gangs and other criminals. It's time for the hero to assemble his group and show those criminals who is the boss!
Tuned Heart is a turn-based strategy game with strong RPG elements. Characters are moved around on vast top-down battle fields, attacking enemies with pistols and other weapons. Characters also receive experience points and gain levels, in a RPG fashion. Beside the usual weapon-related attributes, it is possible to customize the vehicles driven by the characters, and their strength can influence the outcome of battles.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 23.36 MB

Following the defeat of the charismatic religious leader Batlin on Serpent Isle, the Guardian banishes the Avatar to a world that he has already conquered: Pagan. Ultima VIII has a much darker tone and a very different premise, in comparison to most of the Ultima games. The world of Pagan is entirely different from that of Britannia: the Virtues are not part of Pagan's culture, and the magic systems and monsters are entirely different.
The world of Pagan is in eternal twilight as the result of an ancient battle between the Elemental Titans and the evil "Destroyer", which resulted in the victory of the Titans. However, the people of Pagan had to pay a high price: the Titans had to henceforth be worshiped as gods. The Titans bestow powers on their most ardent followers, but they are otherwise cruel and unloving rulers, and their followers terrorize the general population.

meta.desc:

El juego es del tipo "novela visual", con la posibilidad de recolectar objetos para su uso posterior además de la habilidad de viajar a través de universos paralelos, viajar en el tiempo y cambiar la historia, gracias al sistema A.D.M.S. ("Sistema de Mapeado Auto-Divergente"), con él, dependiendo de las esferas recolectadas, se puede colocar una antes de entrar al siguiente escenario, u otro distinto y regresar en el último punto en donde se dejó esa esfera. 
Empieza el modo A.D.M.S. con 2 esferas. Debes encontrarlas a través de universos paralelos, viajes en el tiempo y completar los puzzles mientras que la historia avanza. Si no hay esferas en el reflector, pero sí datos guardados, se puede reiniciar el juego en el menú principal y tienes la opción de elegir la esfera que quedó para cargar una línea de tiempo o continuar sin elegir esferas hasta llegar a uno de los finales. Si se activa la máquina del tiempo, Takuya entrará a uno de los escenarios de cualquier ruta al azar.
